title: Game detail
description: Open a game from the Game nights table so the time range matches it.

list.name: match
list.label: Game
list.query: SELECT match_id AS __value, CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(started_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'),' UTC  ',map,'  ',humans,'p') AS __text FROM matches ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 300

targets.rawSql: SELECT map AS Map, humans AS Players, router_name AS Router, version AS Version, ROUND(duration_s/60) AS Minutes, ROUND(sim_fps,1) AS `Speed fps`, slowest_name AS `Held speed down`, ROUND(felt_s) AS `Frozen s`, ROUND(worst_stall_ms/1000,1) AS `Worst freeze s`, disc_screens AS `Disconnect screens`, desync AS Desync FROM matches WHERE match_id = $match

panels.title: Players

targets.rawSql: SELECT slot AS Slot, name AS Player, IF(reported, IF(finished,'yes','no end'), 'no log') AS `Log`, version AS Version, ROUND(felt_stall_s,1) AS `Frozen s`, ROUND(lag_caused,1) AS `Freeze s caused`, ROUND(stall_s) AS `All waits s`, ROUND(stall_max_ms/1000,1) AS `Worst stall s`, disc_screens AS `Disconnect screens`, ROUND(rep_fps) AS `PC fps`, ROUND(held_back*100) AS `Held speed down %`, ROUND(client_ms,1) AS `Client ms`, ROUND(logic_ms,1) AS `Logic ms`, resend_req AS `Resends asked`, resend_ans AS `Resends served`, ROUND(relayed_share*100) AS `Relayed %`, ping_ms AS `Avg ping ms` FROM match_players WHERE match_id = $match ORDER BY slot

panels.description: Frozen s: waits past their first 100 ms (felt freezes); All waits s also counts the few ms waits that only slow the game. Freeze s caused: see 'Who the game waited on' on the overview. PC fps: what this PC reported to the router; the lowest sets the game speed. Held speed down: share of the game this PC was the slowest and under 54 fps. Client ms: input, UI and drawing per frame (includes any vsync wait). Logic ms: simulation per logic frame.

panels.title: Freezes, by who the game waited on (one point per player who logged it)

targets.rawSql: SELECT at AS time, blamed AS metric, waited_ms/1000 AS value FROM stalls WHERE match_id = $match ORDER BY at

panels.title: Game speed (frames per real second, 60 = full)

targets.rawSql: SELECT at AS time, name AS metric, value FROM (SELECT at, name, (frame - LAG(frame) OVER w) / TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, LAG(at) OVER w, at) AS value FROM netstat WHERE match_id = $match WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY slot ORDER BY at)) x WHERE value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY at

panels.description: Logic frames each player advanced between NETSTAT lines. Dips are stalls; a flat line under 60 is the slowest PC setting the pace.

panels.title: Each PC's fps as the router saw it (lowest sets the speed) (2.1.6 and later clients only)

targets.rawSql: SELECT at AS time, name AS metric, fps AS value FROM peer_fps WHERE match_id = $match AND fps > 0 ORDER BY at

panels.title: Client time per frame: input, UI, drawing (ms) (2.1.6 and later clients only)

targets.rawSql: SELECT at AS time, name AS metric, client_ms AS value FROM netstat WHERE match_id = $match AND client_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY at

panels.description: Average per drawn frame over 10 s. Above 16.7 ms a PC cannot draw 60 fps. Includes the vsync wait on a vsynced PC.

panels.title: Logic time per frame: the simulation (ms) (2.1.6 and later clients only)

targets.rawSql: SELECT at AS time, name AS metric, logic_ms AS value FROM netstat WHERE match_id = $match AND logic_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY at

panels.description: Average per logic frame over 10 s. Every PC runs the same simulation, so a PC far above the rest is a slow CPU.

panels.title: Objects in the game (2.1.6 and later clients only)

targets.rawSql: SELECT at AS time, 'objects' AS metric, objs AS value FROM netstat WHERE match_id = $match AND objs IS NOT NULL AND slot = (SELECT router_slot FROM matches WHERE match_id = $match) ORDER BY at

panels.title: Upload per player, all links (KB/s) (2.1.6 and later clients only)

targets.rawSql: SELECT at AS time, name AS metric, SUM(out_kbps) AS value FROM routes WHERE match_id = $match AND out_kbps >= 0 GROUP BY at, name ORDER BY at

panels.description: The packet router sends everyone's commands, so its upload is the one that can run out.

targets.rawSql: SELECT at AS time, CONCAT(name,' > ',peer) AS metric, ping_ms AS value FROM routes WHERE match_id = $match AND ping_ms >= 0 ORDER BY at

panels.title: Send queue wait per link (ms) (2.1.6 and later clients only)

targets.rawSql: SELECT at AS time, CONCAT(name,' > ',peer) AS metric, queue_ms AS value FROM routes WHERE match_id = $match AND queue_ms >= 0 ORDER BY at

panels.description: How long a new message waits before GNS sends it. Climbing on every link of one player at once = that player's upload is full.

panels.title: Unsent bytes queued per link

targets.rawSql: SELECT at AS time, CONCAT(name,' > ',peer) AS metric, pending AS value FROM routes WHERE match_id = $match AND pending >= 0 ORDER BY at

panels.description: GNS pending reliable + unreliable bytes. A link that stops draining is about to time out (about 10 s).

targets.rawSql: SELECT name AS `From`, peer AS `To`, COUNT(*) AS Samples, ROUND(AVG(relayed)*100) AS `Relayed %`, ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(ping_ms,-1))) AS `Avg ping ms`, MAX(ping_ms) AS `Max ping ms`, MAX(pending) AS `Max queued bytes`, ROUND(AVG(out_kbps)) AS `Avg KB/s out`, MAX(queue_ms) AS `Max queue ms` FROM routes WHERE match_id = $match GROUP BY name, peer ORDER BY 1, 2
